errors.name: BookIsbnDuplicateError
errors.description: Raised when an attempt is made to add a book with an ISBN that is already in the database.

errors.name: BookNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a book is requested by ID but no book with that ID exists in the database.

errors.name: BookIdNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a book is searched or retrieved by ID but no book with that ID exists in the database.
